==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am inside a futuristic computer lab. Floating holographic blue screens are all around. I am perfecting the design of my latest invention.

I am working on creating a humanoid robot. It has a black paint job, silver accents, a single glowing red eye, and a bowl shaped head. This robot is meant to be my magnum opus.

It is designed to be able to recognize, scan, and emulate the powers of superheroes and supervillains. Due to tight deadlines, I am forced to release my super bot early. I am worried about how it will perform in the field, but I hope for the best and monitor it's error logs closely.
